description: This source file defines the LocationAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing location entities within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing location data, with associated validation rules and OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: LocationAPI
classes.description: Defines RESTful API endpoints for managing location data, including operations for CRUD, listing, validation, and internal data population.

methods.description: Returns an instance of LocationService, initializing it if necessary.
